posts.post: I am debating between heavy-weight cotton or a custom performance blend for the first drop. Tell me why I am wrong for picking cotton.
If you could only wear one outfit for the rest of your life what is it and why. Be honest, no trend chasing allowed.
Stop buying clothes that look good on a screen but fall apart in the wash. I am tired of the industry standard being mediocrity. What is the biggest dealbreaker for you when buying a shirt.
